title: Nookumi release information
text: Nookumi Desktop Companion is scheduled for release on August 17, 2026.

title: Nookumi architecture
text: Nookumi uses a Tauri v2 application shell, a Next.js interface, and a Rust backend.

title: Tiny student goal
text: The tiny student should use retrieved evidence for factual claims, answer concisely, and abstain when evidence is insufficient.
